body:
Deep strategic thinking session. Golden docs audit completed (context/golden-docs-sprawl-memo-2026-06-12.md).

Revenue path analysis:
- Track 1: SHANKPIT → Steam EA (6-12 months, first dollars)
- Track 2: Ask Emily newssite product (6-12 months, freemium)
  Blocker: FatBaby MySQL projections + MongoDB graph flattening
- Track 3: Data platform licensing (2+ years, institutional)
- RSI: Emily Prime Brain (parallel enabler)

Backlog additions:
- S19: SHANKPIT → Steam EA (6 items)
- S20: FatBaby Queryability — MySQL + MongoDB (6 items)
- S21: Ask Emily Product (6 items)
- S22: Emily Prime Brain — goldenbuild + dynamic prompt + FABLE (9 items)
- S18: 4 tooling gap items documented

Total open: 37 items across 9 sections.
GOLDEN.md regenerated (~1238 tokens).

Key decisions:
- MongoDB over Neo4j for graph data (no Neo4j ops complexity)
- MySQL CQRS projections for queryable FatBaby read models
- SHANKPIT EA launch with FPS core only (Dragonfly/BedWars post-launch)
- Emily Prime planning endpoint to shift planning off Claude Code tokens
title: Strategic replan 2026-06-12: S19-S22 + tooling gaps
